finding: Geometry provides both actual host Metal rasterization and an actual host Metal field-compute implementation. Neither source implements GPU virtualization or guest transport.

renderer.api: render(solid: Solid3D, camera: Camera, light: DirectionalLight, albedo: RGB, ambient: Double, ks: Double, shininess: Double, width: Int, height: Int) -> Image?
renderer.execution: MTLRenderPipelineState; runtime-compiled vertex vmain and fragment fmain; fan-triangulated flat-normal solid; RGBA8 color/depth attachments; drawPrimitives(.triangle); command-buffer commit/waitUntilCompleted; texture getBytes readback.
renderer.cpuFallback: None in this class. init? returns nil when device/queue/shader/pipeline creation fails. CPU Shading is a reference oracle, not an automatic fallback.
boundaryForFutureWrapping: Bound positive dimensions and allocations. Original render accepts width/height directly.
Require command-buffer status/error after completion. Original code waits but does not explicitly check status before reading bytes.

compute.execution: MTLComputePipelineState fieldEval, shared input/output buffers, dispatchThreads, commit/waitUntilCompleted. Gaussian-well potential and analytic gradient, float32 GPU execution.
compute.output: Evaluation.v and Evaluation.grad converted to Double after Float readback
compute.bounds: maxNodeCount64, nonempty arrays, positive finite sigma; wrapper must additionally bound points and validate finite float conversion and completion status.

tests.name: testGPUMatchesShadingOracle
tests.checks: Three solids, non-sliver front-face centroids, RGB differences <=2/255; at least one face per solid and six total.

tests.name: testDepthOcclusionShowsFrontFaces
tests.checks: Projected cube center is not black clear color; limited sanity check, not exhaustive depth proof.

renderTests.skipBoundary: Skips if init? returns nil; non-Metal platform defines one explicit skipped test. Source is present, no fresh test execution claimed.

RenderKit Phase 2: Metal offscreen renderer (GPU executes the shading oracle)

GeometryRenderMetal: offscreen Metal renderer, runtime-compiled MSL, flat-shaded Lambert+Blinn-Phong in linear space, depth-tested, RGBA8 readback. GeometryKit stays pure: Matrix4 + Camera view/projection matrices, oracle-tested (M1 x/y == project to 1e-9; M2 depth-row near->0/far->1 monotonic — the engine-map's catch that project() doesn't cover depth). GPU matches headless Shading.swift to the byte: 0/255 (octa,cube), 1/255 (tetra) — the honesty gate. RenderMetalTests cross-check + independent-costheta tie (tautology guard) + depth-occlusion sanity. RenderBench + RENDER-BENCH.md first real numbers: mean 0.73ms / p50 0.52ms @512^2, p99 7.1ms, thermal nominal. Engine-map caught the projection w/z-row signs and the depth-near decoupling pre-code (harvested). 544 tests green; zero MasteryKit edits; FigureTests untouched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

primeIntegrationImplication: The field evaluator is the concrete typed compute operation for the current guest-to-host Metal offload. A rendered-image operation would be a separate renderer API integration. Neither establishes a guest-visible GPU device, virtual GPU driver, arbitrary shader ABI or GPU passthrough.
